overview: The City Council Committee of the Whole reviewed the preliminary fiscal year 2027 budgets for the Electrical, Veterans Services, City Clerk, and Building departments. No final actions were taken, and the budget items were kept in committee for further deliberation.

items.title: Electrical Department Budget Review
items.summary: Superintendent Steve Randazzo reported budget increases driven by National Grid rate hikes and the need to replace aging traffic signals to meet ADA compliance.

items.title: Veterans Services Department Budget Review
items.summary: Director Veronica Shaw discussed a decrease in cash aid requirements due to lower enrollment and outlined goals for a new veterans' food pantry and grave restoration projects. The department reported a salary increase for the director following a peer-city study.

items.title: City Clerk’s Office Budget Review
items.summary: Acting Clerk Rich Eliseo presented the budget, emphasizing the transition to the CitizenServe digital licensing platform and a $120,000 proposal to upgrade the office's overstuffed vault. He noted that staffing shortages have increased the workload on remaining full-time employees.

items.title: Building Department Budget Review
items.summary: Chief of Staff Nina Nazarian presented the budget and addressed the transition following the former commissioner's departure, focusing on rising software licensing fees. Council members discussed the department's capacity for code enforcement, specifically regarding persistent leaf blower ordinance violations.
